title: Revo Hospital Growth Strategy: Unlocking Capacity & Reaching +10% Revenue Target
summary: Analysis of hospital capacity constraints and financial performance to identify opportunities for revenue growth.
problem: Revo Hospital experienced a significant surge in patient numbers beginning in December 2024, creating capacity constraints and income disparities.
goal: Identify primary operational and financial bottlenecks
Increase net revenue by 10% over six months
Optimize capacity rebalancing and cash conversion
keyFindings: Oncology recorded the highest ALOS at 6.98 days
Cirebon had the highest pending payment ratio at 17.73%
Central Jakarta generated lower revenue per bed than other flagship branches
recommendations: Review bed allocation between flagship branches
Improve revenue productivity through pricing and payer mix optimization
metrics: Revenue target from Rp98.87B to Rp108.76B
